acceptanceCriteria: A hosted macos-15 CI run exercising the AHI-058 test passes and its run link is retained.
body: AHI-058 (PR #1429) re-probes after an EPERM zombie process group in the Gemini hook adapter. Only local runs observed so far. Expected: passes on hosted macos-15. Actual: NOT_OBSERVED.
title: Qualify AHI-058 Gemini hook EPERM zombie-group re-probe on hosted macos-15 CI
